answer: Your records do not list any allergies or drug intolerances, and no reaction is written against any of your medicines. That does not prove you have none, because allergy lists are often incomplete. The medicines on your record are empagliflozin (Jardiance) 10 mg and atorvastatin 20 mg, both listed as active since 20 February 2025, and metformin, which was stopped on 15 April 2024. If you have ever had a reaction to a medicine, food or anything else, tell your doctor or pharmacist so it is recorded.
